candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) from inventory, causing inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory STATUS_CODE_ERROR timeout with DependencyUnavailable across multiple correlation IDs.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs admitted; whether the timeout stems from redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s; metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2406ms) and 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/saturation metrics to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory service logs correlating redis timeouts with 503 responses
